description.value: Liuyishou Hotpot is the Burnaby outpost of a Chinese hotpot chain with 22 locations across North America, specialising in both all-you-can-eat and dry-fried pot formats. Located on Kingsway, one of Burnaby's main commercial corridors, it offers a full sit-down dining experience rooted in the Chongqing hotpot tradition. A membership programme, birthday specials, and regular community events round out what is otherwise a straightforward table-service restaurant.
